sources.title: Endocannabinoid signaling and synaptic function
sources.authors: Castillo PE, Younts TJ, Chávez AE, Hashimotodani Y
sources.key_contribution: Comprehensive review of eCB-mediated plasticity mechanisms: 2-AG as primary retrograde messenger, DGLα-MAGL synthesis-degradation axis, PLCβ as coincidence detector, eCB-LTD via RIM1α/Rab3B, non-retrograde modes (TRPV1, astrocytic CB1, SSI)

sources.title: An Introduction to the Endogenous Cannabinoid System
sources.key_contribution: CB1R enrichment on CCK+ interneurons; 2-AG as high-efficacy agonist vs AEA as partial agonist; MAGL/ABHD6/ABHD12 degradation pathways; COX-2 metabolism; SSI mechanism; schizophrenia relevance

sources.title: Endogenous cannabinoids mediate retrograde signalling at hippocampal synapses
sources.key_contribution: Landmark discovery establishing eCBs as retrograde messengers at hippocampal synapses; Ca2+-dependent DSI blocked by CB1R antagonist; postsynaptic Ca2+ chelation abolishes DSI
sources.notes: Core findings extensively cited and verified in hundreds of subsequent papers and reviews

sources.title: Cerebellar depolarization-induced suppression of inhibition is mediated by endogenous cannabinoids
sources.key_contribution: Simultaneous discovery of cerebellar DSI via endocannabinoids; AM251 blocks DSI completely; WIN55212-2 mimics and occludes DSI; establishes generality of eCB retrograde signaling

sources.title: Endocannabinoid-mediated control of synaptic transmission
sources.authors: Kano M, Ohno-Shosaku T, Hashimotodani Y, Uchigashima M, Watanabe M
sources.key_contribution: Comprehensive 2009 review of eCB-mediated synaptic control; subcellular distribution of CB1R and biosynthetic enzymes; tonic vs phasic signaling modes

sources.title: Endocannabinoid-mediated synaptic plasticity in the CNS
sources.authors: Chevaleyre V, Takahashi KA, Castillo PE
sources.key_contribution: eCB-LTD at inhibitory (iLTD) and excitatory (eLTD) synapses; temporal characteristics of short vs long-term eCB plasticity; interaction with other plasticity forms

sources.title: Targeting the Endocannabinoid System in the Treatment of Posttraumatic Stress Disorder
sources.authors: Mayo LM, Rabinak CA, Hill MN, Heilig M
sources.key_contribution: CB1R activation in amygdala essential for fear extinction; FAAH inhibition enhances fear extinction in rodents; PF-04457845 FAAH inhibitor 2a phase data for PTSD
sources.notes: Full text not read; clinical claims about FAAH inhibitor trials referenced from abstract. Should verify trial phase and outcome data if used clinically

sources.title: Critical enzymes involved in endocannabinoid metabolism
sources.key_contribution: Enzymatic pathways: NAPE-PLD for AEA, DAGL for 2-AG, FAAH for AEA degradation, MAGL for 2-AG degradation
sources.notes: Core enzyme identity verified by other open-access sources
